zh.title: 波音7月交付53架客機 單月下滑17%同比仍增長
zh.summary: 波音7月共交付53架新飛機；單月量下滑17%；同比表現維持增長
body: 根據 Simple Flying 與路透社（Reuters）報導，波音（Boeing）於 7 月共交付了 53 架飛機。相關數據顯示，波音 7 月的噴射客機交付量較前一個月下降了 17%。
雖然 7 月的交付數量呈現月度下滑，但波音在該月份的整體交付表現與去年同期相比，依然保持著增長趨勢。
報導指出，波音 7 月噴射客機交付量雖然較前一個月減少 17%，但在年度比較的基準上，仍明確超越去年同期的交機數據。
此項數據反映出波音飛機交付量的單月起伏情形，同時也展現出其相較於前一年同期的交機狀況。

en.title: Boeing Delivers 53 Aircraft In July With 17% Monthly Drop
en.summary: Boeing delivered 53 aircraft in July; monthly deliveries dropped 17% while remaining ahead year-on-year.
body: According to reports from Simple Flying and Reuters, Boeing delivered 53 new aircraft in July. Data shows that the aircraft manufacturer's monthly jet deliveries dropped by 17% compared to the previous month.
Despite the month-on-month decrease in output, Boeing's July delivery total remained firmly ahead of the numbers recorded during the same period last year.

The monthly delivery statistics highlight short-term output variations for Boeing jets. Although deliveries experienced a 17% drop month-on-month to 53 aircraft, the year-on-year performance continues to show growth relative to the prior year.
In summary, Boeing handed over 53 aircraft during July, marking a lower monthly delivery output while maintaining a stronger position on a year-on-year comparison.
